title: Unsafe release during pit stop
incident: During a pit stop, Team Aurora's car was released into the pit lane fast lane, causing Team Halcyon's car to brake to avoid contact. The stewards imposed a 5-second time penalty on Team Aurora's driver. The incident occurred in the pit lane, where Team Aurora's car was serviced.

rulings.penalty_stands: The 5-second time penalty stands: Team Aurora's driver must serve the penalty at their next pit stop
rulings.penalty_overturned: The 5-second time penalty is overturned: Team Aurora's driver does not serve the penalty
rulings.further_investigation: The case is referred for further investigation: No penalty is imposed or overturned at this time
